name: Ramesh, Gujarati farmer claiming tadpatri sahay
goal: Buy 2 tarpaulins with a bill the i-Khedut claim will accept, at the best price for a sheet that lasts more than one season.
key_questions: Which GSM and size for harvest and fodder?
What does one 18x24 or 24x30 sheet cost?
Will this bill work for tadpatri sahay, and where can I buy near me?
evidence: Gujarati scheme explainers and YouTube videos for 'tadpatri sahay yojana' (Feb 2025, Mar 2026); Trends 'tadpatri' in Gujarat; Hindi/Gujarati terms dominate marketplace titles.

score_notes.relevance: The GSM and farm guides exist, but nothing mentions i-Khedut, subsidy bills, or 1-2 sheet purchases.
score_notes.clarity: English only, ~240-word pages, no per-sheet prices or sizes in Gujarati; the answer is not findable in 10 seconds.
score_notes.trust: Manufacturer address helps, but the 3.7-star rating, no farmer testimonials and no named people leave doubt.
score_notes.action: WhatsApp/call buttons are low-friction, but no MOQ means a farmer cannot tell whether a 2-sheet order is welcome.

fix_first: Publish a Gujarati page 'તાડપત્રી સહાય યોજના: કઈ તાડપત્રી ખરીદવી' with sizes, GSM, an indicative per-sheet price, the GST-bill note and a WhatsApp button that pre-fills 'i-Khedut, 2 sheets, district'. Route small orders to named Gujarat dealers.

name: Harpreet, mandi trader / FPO buyer racing a rain forecast
segment: Agri traders, mandi/APMC commission agents and procurement-centre operators
goal: Get 50+ large heavy sheets delivered within days, before harvest arrivals meet forecast rain.
key_questions: Do you stock 40x60 ft at 150-200 GSM?
Price per kg and freight to my state?
evidence: News of grain soaked in Haryana and Delhi mandis and paddy under tarpaulins in Telangana; marketplace listings priced per kg by GSM.

score_notes.relevance: The grain storage and GSM guides match the need; large-size availability is not explicit.
score_notes.clarity: No price basis, no stock-size chart with weights, no lead time.
score_notes.trust: No dispatch proof, client names or photos of mandi use; 3.7-star rating.
score_notes.action: WhatsApp is the right channel for urgent buys, but there is no 'urgent bulk' prompt or size calculator.

fix_first: Add a 'Large sizes in stock' block to the tarpaulin and grain-storage pages: size, GSM, weight per sheet, price basis per kg, dispatch time by region, and a WhatsApp button pre-filled with 'size x qty x GSM x pincode'.

name: Neha, construction and warehouse purchase manager
segment: Construction contractors, builders and infra sites / Cold storage, private warehouses and factories
goal: Shortlist a manufacturer that can quote custom sizes on a GST invoice with a firm lead time before the monsoon.
key_questions: Can you make 18x30 m joined sheets or rolls?
What is the MOQ and lead time?
Do you have a spec sheet and past projects?
evidence: Monsoon-shed and custom-size listings on IndiaMART; B2B buyers compare spec sheets and lead times.

score_notes.relevance: The construction, monsoon-shed and machinery/warehouse guides cover the use cases well.
score_notes.clarity: No MOQ, lead time or downloadable spec sheet; short product pages.
score_notes.trust: No certifications, test data, project photos or named contacts.
score_notes.action: Call and WhatsApp exist, but there is no RFQ form or email path a purchase team can file.

fix_first: Add a one-page spec sheet (PDF plus HTML table: GSM tolerance, layers, UV, sizes, MOQ, lead time) and an RFQ form beside WhatsApp; add 3-5 real project photos with location and use.

name: Suresh, dealer or distributor looking for a Gujarat source
goal: Find a reliable manufacturer with consistent GSM, workable MOQ and margin for pre-season stock.
key_questions: What is the dealer price and MOQ per GSM?
Can I get the Indoline brand or my own?
Will batches weigh what the label says?
evidence: IndiaMART Ahmedabad tarpaulin and plastic tarpaulin listings; rainwear wholesalers; marketplace price-per-kg norms.

score_notes.relevance: Products and the brand are present, but there is no dealer offer or page.
score_notes.clarity: No MOQ, price list, margins, territory or freight terms.
score_notes.trust: No factory capacity, years or team shown; 3.7-star rating is visible.
score_notes.action: WhatsApp works, but there is no 'Become a dealer' path.

fix_first: Create a 'Dealers and distributors' page in English, Hindi and Gujarati: MOQ per GSM, price basis, freight, packaging, Indoline branding, a factory photo set and capacity, plus a dealer-inquiry WhatsApp CTA.

name: Pandit-ji, yatra seva committee or route vendor buying ponchos
segment: Pilgrimage and yatra buyers / Festival and procession committees
goal: Buy thousands of cheap ponchos delivered before the yatra or procession date.
key_questions: Is Rs 20 the real price at my quantity?
Will it reach Haridwar, Jammu or Pandharpur in time?
Will it tear on the trek?
evidence: Kedarnath raincoat content ('Kedarnath raincoat Rs 20 Only'); Char Dham poncho reels; record pilgrim counts; 2026 yatra dates.

score_notes.relevance: The poncho page with Rs 20* bulk price and colours matches the core need; there is no yatra framing.
score_notes.clarity: The price is visible above the fold, but the asterisk terms, carton quantity and thickness are missing.
score_notes.trust: No photos of bulk dispatches, no testimonials; 3.7-star rating.
score_notes.action: The WhatsApp button suits this buyer well.

fix_first: Explain the asterisk next to Rs 20* (MOQ, GST, freight) and add carton quantity, thickness and size, and dispatch times to Uttarakhand, J&K and Maharashtra. Add a 'Ponchos for yatras and seva' section timed for March-May.

name: Ankit, brand or CSR manager ordering logo ponchos
segment: Corporate promotional and branded poncho buyers / Schools, NGOs and CSR
goal: Order 5,000-20,000 printed or recyclable ponchos for a June monsoon activation or CSR drive.
key_questions: Can you print our logo, and what is the MOQ for printing?
Lead time to deliver by June?
Is the recyclable poncho claim defensible for our CSR report?
evidence: Printed-poncho listings (Rs 65 at MOQ 200); promotional raincoat printers advertising; NGO raincoat drives; imported promo ponchos at US$0.16-0.19.

score_notes.relevance: Recyclable ponchos are mentioned, but no printing or branding information is shown.
score_notes.clarity: No printing MOQ, colours, mock-up process or lead time.
score_notes.trust: No brand clients, samples or material documentation for the recyclable claim.
score_notes.action: WhatsApp works for an inquiry, but there is no sample request or email path for corporate procurement.

fix_first: If printing is offered, add a 'Custom printed and recyclable ponchos' page with printing MOQ, colours, mock-up turnaround, lead-time calendar ('order by 15 April for June') and a sample-request CTA. If it is not offered, say so and focus the page on recyclable bulk supply.
